sourceNotes: HTTP is a protocol used to request and deliver web resources. A browser sends a request and a server returns a response. HTML gives a web page its structure. CSS controls its appearance. JavaScript adds interaction. An API lets software systems communicate through defined requests and responses. AJAX lets a web page exchange data with a server without reloading the entire page.
